rationale: M49 W22 (F5 rotation finding on sqlite3-wasm.c): #include with a macro-composed argument (INC__STRINGIFY(SQLITE_C)) must not fabricate an include_dependency edge — the path is not statically resolvable (C-D2, preprocessor is textual). Literal quoted/system includes still emit. M60/#910: the edge is the first-class `imports` KIND (the same kind ts/js/python/dart emit), not `references` + metadata — so this fixture pins the ontology, and the forbid block pins that a `references` edge is NOT an acceptable substitute (a downgrade is caught here and by the c/include-kind-downgraded mutant). CONTRACT REPIN (2026-10-25): a QUOTED `#include` is the translation unit's own fragment (the preprocessor splices the header's text into this unit, so the file shares the unit's single scope) and is published as `part_of` with `partRole:"library"` and the part's MODULE SYMBOL as the target (the file stem); the path stays in `metadata.partPath`. An ANGLE include is another module's interface and keeps `imports`. This is a LABEL MOVE plus the target's space (path -> stem, because the arbiter resolves target strings against symbol names): no dependency is gained or lost, and each repinned row gains a forbid row pinning the same target in the old label so a revert goes red.

forbidRelationships.note: a QUOTED include is a part_of row now; the old imports label is forbidden so a revert goes red
and the STEM target too — one edge, one label
